rules.statement: A deed of gift does not create a fideicommissum in favor of the children of the donees unless there is a clear indication of such an obligation imposed by the donor.
rules.supporting_quote: "Where the intention to substitute another for the first is expressed or is to be gathered by necessary implication from language of the will, a fideicommissum is constituted." "Indeed it seems to me that the fact of the property in question being downed property rendered it highly improbable that the grantor would have imposed a fideicommissum on it."
